 WBBL 2026: Match 28, AS W vs MR W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Adelaide Strikers Women vs Melbourne Renegades Women?
 Adelaide Strikers Women will take on the Melbourne Renegades Women in Match 28 of the Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 on Friday, November 20, 2026, at the Adelaide Oval.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 19 Nov 2026, 18:18 IST 
 5 Min Read
 Adelaide Strikers and Melbourne Renegades from WBBL 2025 (Source: Instagram handles of Adelaide Strikers & Melbourne Renegades) Adelaide Strikers Women will take on the Melbourne Renegades Women in Match 28 of the Women's Big Bash League (WBBL) 2026 on Friday, November 20, 2026, at the Adelaide Oval.
 Tahlia McGrath's Strikers side have recovered themselves after an early wobble, but are still not in a solid position, having won three and lost three from six games. They will be looking to improve their results before the final stages of the season
 Sophie Molineux's Renegades side find themselves in a similar phase as the Strikers, with three wins and losses apiece from six games. They will also be looking to better their results in the business end of the season.

 Probable Best Batter: Laura Wolvaardt
 Laura Wolvaardt has been the batting beacon for the Strikers in the 2026 season, having scored 294 runs at a strike rate of 147. She has scored three half-centuries in six innings this season, and will look to continue her form as the business end approaches.
 Probable Best Bowler: Georgia Wareham
